pr_title: Clean-up `Microsoft.Win32.Registry` and remove the non-Windows code.
pr_body:
In a similar vein with other Windows-exclusive libraries, this PR makes the sources of `Microsoft.Win32.Registry` compile only on Windows, removes the non-Windows files (they just threw PNSE), merges the `.Windows` source files and cleans-up some stuff.

Fixes #77974

issue_context.title: Simplify Microsoft.Win32.Registry sources split
issue_context.body: Microsoft.Win32.Registry is Windows only library but contains types that are implemented in multiple source files (e.g. RegistryKey.cs and RegistryKey.Windows.cs). Such files can be folded into single file for easier navigation and maintenance.
